description: Emulsion Flow Technologies (EFT) advances next-generation separation technologies derived from nuclear science to solve critical global resource and environmental challenges. Our proprietary Emulsion Flow process enables highly efficient recovery of rare metals from lithium-ion batteries and selective removal of PFAS from industrial wastewater. By uniting deep scientific expertise with responsible technological innovation, EFT provides scalable solutions that accelerate resource circularity, protect the environment, and support a sustainable, carbon-neutral future.

Enedym is a technology start-up company from McMaster University. The company is headquartered at the McMaster Innovation Park in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. Enedym’s vision is to significantly reduce the cost of electric motors and electrified powertrains, and power a new paradigm in electrification through novel rare earth metals free electric motors, controls, and digitization techniques. Enedym aspires to help save the planet, one electric motor market at a time.

Helm.ai develops AI software for ADAS, autonomous driving, and robotics automation. Founded in 2016, the company delivers full-stack driving software for on-car deployment and simulation tools powered by Deep Teaching™ and generative AI. Helm.ai partners with global automakers on production-bound programs.

INERATEC is a pioneer in the field of power-to-X applications and supplies sustainable e-Fuels and e-Chemicals to replace fossil-based products. In modular chemical plants, they use renewable hydrogen and CO2 to produce climate-friendly e-SAF, e-Gasoline, e-Diesel, and synthetic waxes. These are essential for the defossilization of aviation, shipping, heavy-duty transport, and the chemical industry.

Mythic is ushering in a new era of accelerated computing with its Analog Processing Units (APUs)—a fundamentally different approach to AI inference that collapses compute and memory into a single plane solving the biggest problem of AI, energy efficiency. By overcoming the memory bottlenecks of traditional digital architectures, Mythic delivers unparalleled, hundred fold performance-per-watt in AI workloads in data centers as well as edge systems in robotics, automotive and defense industries.

Nexeon develops and manufactures advanced silicon-based anode materials for lithium-ion batteries, supporting a carbon-neutral future. Its technology enables higher energy density for rapid charging and lighter, more cost-effective batteries. These improvements enhance performance across consumer and commercial applications including electric vehicles. Based in Oxfordshire UK, with operations in Korea and Japan, Nexeon has a skilled, multidisciplinary team driving innovation in battery technology.

Niron Magnetics is the world’s only producer of high‑performance, rare‑earth‑free permanent magnets. Its iron nitride technology powers critical applications across automotive, industrial, consumer electronics, and defense sectors. Niron is scaling a new standard in magnet performance and supply — enabling the advanced systems that power motion across the modern world.

nT-Tao is developing a compact, high-density fusion energy system designed to deliver 20 MW of distributed, baseload power in a modular form factor. The company’s approach combines innovative pulsed-power heating with advanced stellarator confinement to achieve ultra-high plasma densities in a small footprint. nT-Tao targets fast, cost-effective deployment of fusion for applications such as data centers, maritime transport, heavy industry, remote sites, and off-grid energy resilience.

Princeton NuEnergy is a U.S. platform for advanced battery materials manufacturing, delivering cost-effective, capital-efficient production of battery-grade Cathode Active Material (CAM) for lithium-ion batteries. Built on a proprietary, closed-loop system, PNE’s capabilities include Direct Recycling (Cathode-to-Cathode®), Advanced Black Mass™ production, and Upcycled CAM, supporting a stronger domestic battery supply chain and U.S. energy independence.

Reverion develops and builds fuel cell power plants with electrical efficiencies of up to 80%, making them the most efficient in the world. Reverion’s systems are reversible: When electricity prices are high, the units generate power from gas while capturing CO₂. When prices drop, they switch to electrolysis to produce green gases such as hydrogen or methane. By enabling CO₂ storage, they operate CO₂-negative. The power plants of the future, available today.

Seurat is an American-born and built 3D-printed metal parts contract manufacturer. They don’t sell printers—they deliver finished parts. Using their proprietary Area Printing® technology, Seurat provides serial production of high-volume, industrial-scale metal components. They give customers the design and production freedom to reimagine what is possible at scale, unlocking future potential for their products and business.

SiLC Technologies is on a mission to enable the next industrial revolution, where machines perceive, reason, plan, and act alongside humans in true collaboration. Targeted to robotics, mobility, perimeter security, and industrial automation applications, the company’s breakthrough 4D+ vision systems detect velocity and motion, enabling machines to see the world with unprecedented detail and precision. Leveraging extensive silicon photonics expertise, SiLC delivers advanced perception solutions that accelerate the rise of Physical AI.
